title: SystemPathologyDiagnosticReport
description: Structured output schema for system pathology analyses. Enables tracking, comparison, and longitudinal monitoring across analyses.

completeness.description: Process completeness — deliberately SEPARATE from knowledge uncertainty. draft = structure or research steps unfinished; partial = core material/process/scope coverage insufficient; complete_with_uncertainty = the agreed analytical work is done while mechanisms and facts remain uncertain. There is no state meaning 'process complete therefore facts true'.

analysis_contract.description: Agreed before analysis starts; the yardstick the delivery is judged against

objective.description: The decision this analysis must inform

user_authority.description: What the reader can actually do — action cards must not exceed this

as_of.description: Knowledge cutoff for the whole analysis

stopping_rules.description: Written BEFORE the run: core mechanisms covered / remaining gaps don't change the action / retrieval only returns same-family material / budget exhausted

system_name.description: Full name of the system analyzed

analyst_confidence.description: Overall confidence in the analysis given available information

tier.description: T1/T2/T3 only — unified with researcher-base.md and ach_score.py. Tier describes the source's material type, NOT the truth of any claim it carries.

information_gaps.description: Key information that couldn't be obtained and limits confidence

cartography.description: Structural map of the system before diagnosis

formal_informal_gap.description: Gap between org chart and actual decision-making paths

ach.description: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses — alternative explanations tested against evidence

status.description: eliminated = conditionally refuted under the listed evidence and the current C/I/N coding — NOT proven false. 'not yet excluded' must never be rewritten as 'established', and ACH scores are not posterior probabilities.

independent_family_count.description: Independent source families, not raw evidence rows — reprints count once

elimination_evidence.description: Which evidence conditionally refuted this hypothesis (if eliminated)

source_family.description: Reprints/translations of one original share this id and are collapsed to a single weight

sensitivity.description: Which conclusions survive perturbation — drop the heaviest evidence family, collapse same-family reprints, flip a contested C/I/N coding

compensating_effects.description: Where strength in one dimension offsets weakness in another

highest_leverage_points.description: Meadows-style leverage points where small changes have large system effects

name.description: Precise name — specific enough to act on

failure_cascade.description: Ordered sequence of events if this node fails

system_archetype.description: One-phrase characterization: 'mature institution in slow decay', 'growth-stage entity hitting scaling limits', etc.

scenario_set.description: Conditional scenarios built from the specific uncertainties of THIS system. There is no default three-way split, and probabilities are optional.

is_probability_distribution.description: True only when the scenarios are mutually exclusive and exhaustive over the same horizon AND a defensible probability basis exists. Only then may probabilities sum to 1.

driving_uncertainties.description: The external shocks, internal mechanisms and available actions the scenarios are constructed from

scenarios.description: Conditional evolution paths. NOT a fixed heat-death/bifurcation/emergence triad — those are discussion metaphors, not an exhaustive event set for every system.

type.description: Free-form label for this scenario's mechanism; no fixed taxonomy

probability.description: Omit or null when no defensible basis exists — 'cannot give a probability' is a legitimate output

probability_basis.description: Required whenever probability is non-null: what the number is derived from (base rate, model, expert range). No basis → no number.

robust_actions.description: Actions that remain defensible under this scenario — preferred output over forced probabilities under deep uncertainty

mechanism.description: Why this works, not just what to do

specific_actions.description: Concrete enough to execute on Monday morning

resistance.description: Who will oppose this and why

positive_spillover.description: Other dimensions incidentally improved, with mechanism

conflicts_with.description: Other prescription titles this one contradicts

monitoring_dashboard.description: Leading indicators for ongoing health tracking

predictions.description: Falsifiable predictions derived from the diagnosis. Probabilities express judgement — there is NO required mix of high- and low-confidence entries.

event_type.description: Determines which early adjudications are legitimate. occurrence = happens at least once before the deadline; persistence = holds until the deadline; point_in_time = the state/value at the deadline; conditional = adjudicated only after the trigger fires.

adjudication_window.description: When the prediction may be judged, and in which timezone

adjudication_sources.description: Priority order of sources used to adjudicate, plus how missing data is handled — frozen at registration

trigger_condition.description: For conditional predictions: what must happen before adjudication starts

mechanism_id.description: The mechanism card this prediction is derived from

frozen_at.description: Registration timestamp; updates create a NEW version rather than overwriting

candidate_predictions.description: Predictions considered but not selected for the final set

claims.description: Assertion-level evidence ledger. The audit chain is source → claim → mechanism → judgment → forecast/action; every object below has a stable id and typed relations.

status.description: supported = supported BY THE LISTED MATERIAL under the stated definitions; not a claim of permanent truth

loads.description: Ids of dimensions / mechanisms / risk nodes / predictions / actions that depend on this claim

event_time.description: When the described event happened (empty if unknown — never substitute the retrieval date)

source_family.description: Original-origin family id; reprints, translations and quotations of one original share it and count once

directness.description: How directly this material bears on THIS claim — an official document proves 'the rule was published', not 'the rule worked'

interest.description: Interest the publisher/observer has in the claim being true

locator.description: Page / paragraph / timestamp of the excerpt

reachability.description: Reachability is NOT verification status — keep them separate

faithfulness_checked.description: Whether the paraphrase was checked back against the original sentence for subject/source/direction reversal

needs_review.description: Set on dependents when a load-bearing claim is contradicted or withdrawn

claim_type.description: Determines how fast this claim goes stale. There is no single threshold that fits all material: an officeholder claim is stale in a week, a charter rule in two years, a historical fact never.

valid_from.description: When the described state started holding

valid_to.description: When it stopped holding (empty = still holds as of `as_of`)

mechanisms.description: Mechanism cards — the minimum analytical unit. A mechanism explains an observation via actors, rules and intermediate steps, and must name what would take it down.

explains.description: Phenomenon, object, time window and comparison baseline

chain.description: Which actors, under which rules and constraints, do what, through which intermediate process, producing which outcome

name.description: A concrete variable — 'incident reporting delay', 'cash buffer' — not 'D3'

alternatives.description: At least one alternative explanation leading to a different observation or action; if none is plausible, describe the search that established that

discriminating_predictions.description: What we should additionally see if THIS mechanism holds rather than the alternatives

action_impact.description: Which choice it changes; if it changes none, state its explanatory value instead

causal_level.description: L1 gives conditional direction only. L2 requires units/data/defensible expert ranges plus sensitivity checks. L3 requires an estimand and a defensible identification strategy. Never emit L3-style effect promises from L1 arrows or ordinal scores.

dimension_link.description: Seven dimensions serve as navigation/retrieval labels for this mechanism, not as the mechanism itself

actions.description: Action cards — an action must be executable by a named role, verifiable, and bounded by guardrails.

first_step.description: First deliverable move, its preconditions and definition of done

alternatives.description: Hold / gather more evidence / run a trial / intervene — with the trade-off

outcome_metric.description: Prefer an independent outcome metric over the metric the action itself targets

decision_triggers.description: What new evidence starts, defers, escalates or cancels it

blocked_by_claims.description: Unresolved high-stakes claims that make this action non-recommendable for now

coverage_audit.description: Element-group coverage audit. This is an audit table, not a fixed twelve-chapter outline — unknowns that materially affect the current decision get priority; low-relevance items need no expansion.

affects_current_decision.description: If true and status is unknown, it must surface in the summary or in an action's conditions

boundary_sensitivity.description: Does the conclusion survive including/excluding one important actor?

judgement_changes.description: On repeat analysis: what was added, withdrawn or retained, and why

change_type.description: A measurement-basis change is NOT a system change — check comparability before reading it as improvement

historical_analogies.description: Top-3 structurally similar historical cases by magnitude-aware 7-dim distance similarity

match_type.description: partial = fewer than 6 scored dimensions; must be presented as insufficient coverage, never as a structural match

coverage.description: e.g. "7/7" — how many dimensions the similarity was computed over

outcome_is_hindsight.description: Case scores were coded with the outcome already known. Analogies generate leads to test; they do not produce probabilities of occurrence.

key_differences.description: Where current system diverges from this analogy

dimension_basis_version.description: Per-dimension scoring-basis version, e.g. {"D3": "v2"}. When it changes, historical scores for that dimension are NOT directly comparable — a metric redefinition is not a system change.

measurement_changes.description: Registered changes to how something is measured, so cross-period comparison can refuse to read them as system change

analysis_id.description: Immutable version id, e.g. "20260908-002". Saving twice in one day yields two versions; neither overwrites the other.

supersedes.description: analysis_id of the version this one follows

score.description: Health score calibrated against scoring-calibration.md anchor cases. Use "unknown" when evidence is missing and "not_applicable" when the dimension does not apply — never a mid-range number as a stand-in.

score_basis_version.description: Version of the scoring anchors/definition used. Changing it makes historical scores non-comparable.

score_range.description: Report a range instead of a point score when the score would differ materially across surviving hypotheses

trajectory.description: Direction of travel over last 12 months

key_findings.description: 2-3 most important observations for this dimension

evidence.description: Observable facts or data points supporting the score

confidence.description: Confidence in this dimension's score given available data
